name: Yukuhashi (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Yukuhashi city emblem in red: two facing curved strokes, like a stylised letter W.
history: Municipal flag of Yukuhashi, a city in Fukuoka Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 10 October 1954.

features.role: Yukuhashi city emblem — two facing curved strokes, like a stylised letter W
